rich2021Math: Original IM2021 Grade5 U05:L17 multiplies whole numbers by tenths/hundredths. The objective is to show a model or justify decimal unit magnitude using whole-number multiplication, not to recite a decimal placement trick.
Warm-up source TRUE/FALSE equations are100×0.01=1 TRUE,10×0.1=0.01 FALSE because equals1, and10×0.01=0.1 TRUE. Teacher asks how changing place value changes grouped quantities.

Activity1 original source problems2×0.7=1.4,2×0.08=0.16 and2×0.78=1.56. Unit hundredth diagrams and place-value sum1.4+0.16=1.56 demonstrate why tenths and hundredths combine; original diagrams and explanations require teacher review.

Activity2 source asks3×0.5=1.5,5×0.3=1.5 and7×0.02=0.14; Kiran argues multiply as whole numbers then call them tenths. Refine Kiran's language with 6×0.07=(6×7) hundredths =0.42, NOT4.2 or42. Teacher reviews original strategy critique.

Previous mathematically valid alternate 3×0.6 etc examples stay only independently authored extensions, not the original source problem list. Source Cool-down is gated and an independent Edulytiks teacher-scored Cool-down is separate.
